subject.title: fix(mattermost): backfill thread history from server when in-memory window is empty

question: After the marker bug is fixed, should this PR be the canonical Mattermost thread-history recovery fix, and is one bounded server thread fetch per stored session acceptable?
rationale: The code defect is mechanically repairable, but the final land decision still owns a session-state and availability tradeoff and must choose between two open candidate PRs for the same canonical issue.

options.title: Repair And Canonicalize This PR
options.body: Fix the absent-session marker edge case, refresh against current main, and use this proof-sufficient branch as the canonical fix.

options.title: Pick The Sibling Candidate
options.body: Fresh-review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93243 instead if maintainers prefer that implementation shape, then close this PR only after the sibling is viable or merged.

options.title: Pause For Owner Direction
options.body: Hold both candidates until a Mattermost/session owner chooses the permanent recovery semantics and inbound fetch budget.

recommendation.title: Repair And Canonicalize This PR
recommendation.body: Fix the absent-session marker edge case, refresh against current main, and use this proof-sufficient branch as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses shared inbound history semantics and Mattermost plugin recovery behavior, both areas touched by steipete's recent history refactor.
